observation: After all seven books were shelved, the person swapped three pairs. The four books without visible red tabs ended up on the left, and the three with red tabs ended up together on the right.
interpretation: The swaps suggest the person may prefer to group books by whether they have a red tab. The images leave the tabs’ meaning and the order within each group unclear.
note: Next time I shelve these books, I’ll keep the red-tabbed ones together on the right. That matches how the person arranged them this time.
